capabilities: > Check pasted text against regex rules
> Create new notes based on rules
> Embed new notes into active note
> Apply templates to new note content
motivation: I like using the obsidian-plotly plugin to render interactive figures in my notes. The Plotly figure is represented as JSON and placed in a code block, which is replaced with the rendered figure in the editor. However, when editing the note or interacting with the plot, the code block sometimes collapses back into its unrendered, editable form.
problem: Manually creating and embedding notes for complex data formats, such as Plotly JSON, is effortful and can lead to rendering issues in the editor.

relations.evidence: Parts of this plugin are directly derived (see source comments) from parts of the following plugins: - obsidian-admonition
I took inspiration from obsidian-custom-attachment-location concerning the customization of note and folder naming.

summary: Rule-based paste handler that checks clipboard content against regex patterns, creating a new note and embedding it into the active note upon a match.
